title: Whodunit at the Art Heist
story: In the dimly lit galleries of the Renaissance Art Museum, a dazzling piece of art caught the eye of art enthusiast, Detective Jane Doe. The painting in question, 'The Night Watchman', was believed to be a genuine Van Gogh masterpiece, but something seemed off about it. Suddenly, the museum alarm went off, signaling an intrusion. Our dear detective was summoned to the scene.
crimeScene: The crime occurred in the museum's Renaissance Gallery, with 'The Night Watchman' painting as the prime suspect.
forensicClue: The time on the security camera footage (11:37 PM) contradicts the CCTV's maintenance log (11:42 PM), raising questions about the integrity of the recorded evidence.
question: Who stole 'The Night Watchman' and how is the questionable security footage connected?
options: Option A (Curator Linda's alibi and motive)
Option B (Security Tech Mark's alibi and motive)
Option C (Gallery Attendant Bob's alibi and motive)
Option D (Conservationist Sarah's alibi and motive)
